worldcombat.skill.brutalswing.summary: Sinks low, then spins its whole body through one full circle: every foe within reach takes one physical hit and is flung outward. It ends standing and never slows itself. The broad form reaches wider and throws harder at the cost of a lighter hit and a slower turn.
worldcombat.skill.brutalswing.use.0: Sweep a full circle when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.brutalswing.use.1: Break up a close-quarters surround and fling the nearby foes off
worldcombat.skill.brutalswing.use.2: Close-range cover that costs no Speed: one turn and it is over
worldcombat.skill.brutalswing.descriptio: Spins one full circle on the spot, hitting every foe within %2$s blocks of the user once each, in any direction, for %1$s physical damage. Real walls block the blade; only the side actually swept is struck, including foes that step into the blade path.
Each swept foe is flung outward up to %1$s blocks (less when blocked); the full turn takes about %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.brutalswing.wide.on: Broad form: radius x1.18, knock-back x1.3 and +3 ticks per full turn; costs impact power x0.85, wind-up +2 ticks, recovery +3 ticks and cooldown +6 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.brutalswing.wide.off: Tight form: spins closer, shorter and faster with a heavier single hit; but throws less and cannot reach farther foes.
worldcombat.skill.brutalswing.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.brutalswing.growth.0: From level %1$s the sweep power rises to %2$s and the radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.brutalswing.growth.1: From level %1$s the sweep power rises to %2$s and the knock-back to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.brutalswing.preference: On: radius x1.18, farther knock-back and a wider reach, at the cost of impact power x0.85, wind-up and recovery +3 ticks each, cooldown +6 ticks. Off (tight): closer, shorter and faster with a heavier single hit, but throws less and cannot reach farther foes.
The companion only considers the sweep when a threat is within this distance. Smaller spins only at contact, larger dives into a crowd first.
Spins only with at least this many visible hostile foes inside the sweep radius. Higher reserves it for being surrounded; 1 spins at a single foe.
